title: First interview with Travis Walton after his alien abduction experience, 1975
description:
Date interview: November 11, 1975.

Date of UFO incident: November 5, 1975. Apache-Sitgreaves National Forests near Snowflake, Arizona.

0:00 – Introduction & interview setup
0:30 – Travis begins recounting the drive home and first sighting of the UFO
1:25 – Getting out of the truck and approaching the craft
2:05 – The strike / losing consciousness
2:35 – Waking up on the craft (pain, light, table)
3:40 – First sight of the small beings
4:30 – Description of the small beings (appearance, clothing, height)
5:15 – Fighting / lashing out at the beings
6:00 – Beings leave; Travis alone in the room
7:00 – Leaving the room → curving hallway
7:50 – Entering the control room / seeing stars through the walls
8:50 – Examining the chair and controls
9:25 – Arrival of the human-looking man with the helmet
10:20 – Being led out of the first craft (airlock / ramp)
11:00 – Hangar area with other craft
12:00 – Led to another room with more human-looking people (dressed in blue)
13:00 – Attempts to communicate / being seated
14:00 – The mask is placed over his face / blacking out
15:00 – Questions about physical condition after return & why he avoided media at first
17:00 – Jim Lorenzen (APRO) joins the discussion
18:30 – Further questions about the beings, the craft, and the experience
21:00 – Discussion of evidence, witnesses, and public reaction
23:30 – Closing comments  

ALSO WATCH: 
Travis Walton and his brother Duane talk about the 1975 UFO sighting and alien abduction experience: https://youtu.be/cAjZxClrdCQ
